thread:
maya-chen: kicking off Orion-13B onboarding. weights are in s3://redwood-models/orion-13b/v1/ (split shards). tokenizer is BPE with an unusual UNK id=1 (we usually expect 3) so watch the wrapper behavior.

maya-chen: quick sanity check: model.json reports "max_position_embeddings": 8192 but our default serving config has seq_len=4096. I'd like to confirm which is correct before we tune batch sizes.

leo-wu: I ran a local triton load test on a CUDA12.2 host and got a kernel selection failure for flash_attn on sm_80. log extract:
```
E Triton: ModelOrion-13B failed to load
KernelSelectionError: No kernel for op flash_attn for compute capability 8.0 with current plugin build (built for CUDA 11.x)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/triton/server.py", line 278, in _load_model
    plugin.load()
  File "/opt/triton/plugins/flash_attn/loader.py", line 120, in load
    raise KernelSelectionError(msg)
```

dmitri-petrov: that matches what I saw earlier on a different node. Our runtime image tag redwood/runtime:stable is still CUDA 11.8 + Triton 23.08, so plugin ABI mismatch is expected. We need a container rebuild against CUDA 12.2 or a plugin rebuild.

samir: is there a quick fallback to keep e2e smoke passing? Maybe force CPU fallback for that op or set REDWOOD_ENABLE_SOFTFALLBACK=1 to use slower kernels.

dmitri-petrov: yes, set REDWOOD_ENABLE_SOFTFALLBACK=1 or REDWOOD_FALLBACK_KERNEL=matmul. Perf will be terrible but OK for CI sanity.

ci-bot: pipeline queued: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/actions/9012 - runtime/orion-cuda12.2-build (queued)

ops-bot: FYI we only have two CUDA12.2-capable builders (builder-c12-01, builder-c12-02). Expect build contention if multiple PRs land.

maya-chen: thanks. I inspected model.json:
```
"max_position_embeddings": 8192,
"vocab_size": 50688
```
So serving seq_len should be 8192. Also tokenizer metadata shows unk_id=1, pad_id=0, eos_id=2. Our loader asserts unk_id==3 historically. I'll add a compatibility shim rather than rewrite all existing tooling.

rajiv: I'll add a tiny wrapper: if tokenizer.unk_id != expected then map_specials = True and set internal expectations accordingly. Also add unit tests for 20 prompts.

leo-wu: repro commands I used on a builder node:
```
ssh builder-c12-01
docker run --gpus all -it --rm \
  -e REDWOOD_ENABLE_SOFTFALLBACK=0 \
  -v /mnt/models:/models \
  redwood/runtime:stable bash -lc "python -c \"from runtime import server; server.load_model('Orion-13B')\""
# produced kernel selection error when fallback env unset
```

dmitri-petrov: quick ldd check on plugin if someone can run before we rebuild:
```
ldd /opt/triton/plugins/flash_attn/libflash_attn.so
# check for libcuda, libcudart links; if they point to /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcudart.so.11 -> rebuild required
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap --format=csv
```

samir: while rebuild is queued, suggest we add a canary override in deploy configs to limit seq_len=1024 and set REDWOOD_ENABLE_SOFTFALLBACK=1 so smoke won't OOM. I'll prepare the patch.

maya-chen: PR incoming to models-configs to set seq_len=8192 and note tokenizer shim. Holding merge until runtime confirms plugin rebuild.

ci-bot: started runtime build: redwood/runtime:orion-cuda12.2-20260314 - logs: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/bb9d/logs/12

ops-bot: scheduled builder reservation: 2026-03-14 03:30 UTC on builder-c12-01 (2h window). Ping if you need earlier.

rajiv: unit tests: tokenizer roundtrip on 20 prompts passed locally. Patch attached to PR comment. Will rerun once runtime image is ready.

dmitri-petrov: build logs show plugin recompile started. If plugin still fails on sm_80, we may need to also bump Triton minor (23.11) to get proper plugin API for CUDA12.

leo-wu: reproduced after new image pulled, load now fails with undefined symbol missing from libcudart.so.12 -> indicates flash_attn built against wrong cudart. Rebuilding plugin with CUDA12 toolchain fixed on dev node.

samir: I've added the temporary canary override and soft-fallback env in the deploy repo. If runtime passes smoke, we can merge model config and roll a canary.

ci-bot: runtime image build succeeded: redwood/runtime:orion-cuda12.2-20260314 (sha256:cafefeed...). smoke tests queued.

maya-chen: thanks all — will merge models-configs PR after smoke green and monitor canary. If anything fails, we revert to REDWOOD_ENABLE_SOFTFALLBACK=1.

leo-wu: quick note for postmortem: add checklist item "confirm plugin build CUDA toolchain matches target host CUDA" to onboarding docs.

maya-chen: agreed. updated onboarding checklist in PR comment. last_message_ts: 1830004600 :white_check_mark:
